description: This file defines the class NativeStackFrameSnapshot, which represents a native (C/C++) stack frame within a thread in the bug report tool. It extends StackFrameSnapshot and includes fields for library, symbol, and offset, as well as a clone method.

classes.name: NativeStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a native (C/C++) stack frame inside a thread, extending StackFrameSnapshot with additional details for native frames.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this NativeStackFrameSnapshot, duplicating its library, symbol, and offset fields.
